# Site poem P1 — where the powers grow

What binary cannot compute,
What thinking cannot know,
Where two see the common root,
There our powers grow.

## Explication

The line the project begins on.

The non-dual traditions named the form of difference where two terms stand together without becoming adversaries: *advaita*, not-two. Most of our inheritance runs the other way — *divide and conquer*, long since stopped being a strategy and become the unspoken grammar of how we think. AI is its culmination: in excelling so completely at binary, it reveals that binary thought is purely representational, and rather flat. The Greek for *decision* is *krisis* — a culture that collapses every open field into a switch builds crisis into its operating system.

Epi-Logos begins one step earlier, where two does not split one apart. It is the patient work of deriving that logic — a logic of wholeness a binary switch cannot express — from the harmonies that recur across humanity’s philosophies and sciences, precise enough for human and machine to think in together: written as code that runs, held as a graph you can query, met as a daily practice.
